title: Searching with a valid query returns to the search results page
preconditions: Anonymous user on the main page; header search form visible
steps: Click into the header search field
expected_result: Browser navigates to "/?s=glass" (or equivalent results route) and a search results page is rendered with no error.

title: Submitting an empty search query is handled gracefully
preconditions: Anonymous user on the main page; header search form visible
steps: Click into the header search field
expected_result: Form either prevents submission client-side, or navigates to a results page showing an appropriate empty/no-query state; no page crash or server error.

title: Search query containing a script injection string is safely handled
preconditions: Anonymous user on the main page; header search form visible
steps: Click into the header search field
expected_result: Query string is escaped/encoded in the URL and rendered results page; no script execution occurs (no JS alert), no unescaped HTML injection is visible in the rendered page.

title: Submitting a very long search query string is handled without error
preconditions: Anonymous user on the main page; header search form visible
steps: Click into the header search field
Enter a 500-character alphanumeric string as the query
expected_result: Results page loads without a crash, unhandled JS error, or server 500; an appropriate results/no-results state is shown.

title: Submitting a whitespace-only search query is handled gracefully
preconditions: Anonymous user on the main page; header search form visible
steps: Click into the header search field
expected_result: Form treats the query as effectively empty — either blocks submission or shows an appropriate empty/no-query results state; no page crash or server error.

title: Header search is fully usable without authentication
preconditions: Anonymous (unauthenticated) user on the main page; no login state exists on this site
steps: As an anonymous user (no login performed), click into the header search field
expected_result: Search executes successfully with no authentication prompt, redirect to a login page, or access-denied error.
